reconstruction_summary: Reproduced V1 (KS recalibrated + per-segment straight-line yaw-gyro bias) using the same equations as triage.v1_ks_recalibrated, with per-platform L from parameters.py; biases recomputed per segment from its own straight (|delta|<0.01) samples.
notes: V1 = KS recalibrated with per-segment yaw-gyro bias subtracted; bias = mean(pred_KS - meas) over rows with |delta_road|<0.01. Applied per-platform wheelbase L (Mach-E 2.984 m, Lightning 3.70 m). Agent originally evaluated only on Mach-E; canonical eval extends to all 545 Ford segments.
